column1: # Stroke colours corrected after looking at every 상용한자 drawn with brush outlines (tools/build_parts_data.py reads
# this). kanji<TAB>tags<TAB>reason; tags = one letter per stroke in writing order: r radical (red), p sound part
# (blue), - other. Found by an audit of 45 sheets of all 2,136 상용한자 (each flag checked by two judges against
# the origin note) and a check of every kanji whose blue strokes had no named sound part.
